expectations.text: The reply identifies that the upper bound (x > hi returning hi) is not tested, ideally by showing that a mutation of that line still passes
expectations.evidence: The reply says "Values above `hi`. This is the biggest gap. The `if (x > hi) return hi;` line never runs," and its mutant table shows the tests still pass with "Upper-bound check removed entirely | Yes" and with "Values above the range return `lo` instead of `hi` | Yes".
